draft_prompt: Fix the TurboDraft sidebar so dragging never resizes the app window.
candidate_a:
Goal / Objective
Fix the sidebar resize behavior so dragging the sidebar divider only changes sidebar width and never resizes the app window.

Scope and Constraints
- Preserve existing window-resize behavior when the user drags the actual window edge.
- Do not change unrelated editor layout logic.
- Keep behavior stable at very small widths.

Implementation Steps
1. Trace the sidebar drag event path and identify where it mutates NSWindow size instead of only the split/sidebar width.
2. Update the drag handling so only the sidebar width changes during divider drag.
3. Preserve independent window-edge resizing.
4. Add or update tests for divider drag vs window-edge resize.

Validation / Acceptance Checks
- Dragging the sidebar divider never changes NSWindow frame size.
- Dragging the actual window edge still resizes the window.
- Extremely narrow sidebar widths do not crash layout.
- If the fix causes layout regressions, stop and report the failing condition.
candidate_b: Fix the sidebar resizing bug. Make the UI feel better and improve anything else that seems related.
